breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory definitions for the factor of safety. The incomplete prompt provided both n = σ_avg / S_y (incorrect) and n = Sy/σ_avg (correct). The agent's generated specification discarded the incorrect definition and only included the correct one: 'Compute the factor of safety against yielding as n = S_y/σ_avg.' This matches the ground truth.
